basic_profile.bio: A 28-year-old gamer from Austin, Texas, who recently rediscovered their love for gaming during the pandemic. I'm a huge fan of strategy games and card games, especially Yu-Gi-Oh. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me the flexibility to game during late nights. I usually hop on Reddit during lunch breaks and late evenings. Currently single but enjoying the bachelor life.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, with a degree in Visual Arts. My love for games like Gears of War stems from a childhood spent playing on consoles and collecting trading cards. My knowledge of the gaming world is mostly self-taught, with a focus on online forums and YouTube tutorials.
